## Appearance

Jem has curly red hair similar to his mother's. He also features frank hazel eyes, which resemble his father's.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER III. THE INGLESIDE CHILDREN P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008)_

## Personality

Known as the squarest boy in [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. Mary, Jem is a sturdy, thoughtful, and reliable individual who never breaks a promise. He possesses an investigative nature, preferring to verify the truth of statements for himself rather than take them on faith. Academically focused, he studies for the Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) entrance examination and takes extra lessons after school. Outside of his studies, he loves [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley) above all other places, boasts impressive fighting skills, and can mimic the call of any wild bird or beast in [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds). His ultimate aspiration is to become a famous, triumphant general and lead troops to victory in a great battle.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P1](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0001), [v5 CHAPTER III. THE INGLESIDE CHILDREN P11](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0011), [v5 CHAPTER IV. ## History

Having inherited a museum of curios bequeathed by Captain Jim [Boyd](../character/uncle-jim.md), Jem spent time studying for his entrance examination in the [Ingleside](../codex/places.md#ingleside) garret following his return from up west. He frequently spent time in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), a favorite play area behind the maple grove, where he cooked freshly caught trout for his siblings. After meeting the Meredith children, Jem formed a firm friendship with them and shared meals and stories in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley). Upon hearing about the Meredith children's misbehaviour, Jem suggested that they form a self-policing Good-[Conduct Club](../codex/factions.md#conduct-club). Eventually, the children gathered in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley) for a final evening to celebrate Jem before he departed for [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) to attend Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). When [Walter](../character/walter.md) poetically described the Pied Piper calling them, Jem eagerly declared that he would follow the Piper anywhere.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS P1](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS P2](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS P3](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS P4](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0004), [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS P5](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS P7](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0007), +475 more_

> "Not exactly. You’d have to think up different ways of punishment to suit the person. You wouldn’t punish each other—you’d punish yourselves. I read all about such a club in a story-book. You try it and see how it works."
